title: French farmer meets an NHI holding a tray of soil samples
summary: Michael Shellenberger tells of French farmer meets an NHI holding a tray of soil samples, about an unknown time at France, and reports it citing named sources. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: there's this great case in France where a you know a very trusted respected farmer discovers a a spaceship on his land and then he goes up to it and then there's supposedly an nhi there holding a tray full of of soil samples

plain: A journalist named Michael Shellenberger, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, retells a case he credits to Jacques Vallee, a longtime researcher of UFO reports. According to Shellenberger, a trusted and respected farmer in France found a spaceship on his land, walked up to it, and found a non-human intelligence, meaning a being that is not human, standing there holding a tray full of soil samples. If true, it would suggest visitors who are quietly studying the Earth itself.
